Hi all — quick note from Redwood Finance/Delivery:

We can support two billing workflows, and each has a slightly different onboarding checklist: 

A) Marketplace private offer (AWS/GCP):
- Benefit: Charges appear on your cloud bill; cloud provider handles invoicing and taxes
- Requirements from Sirius Edge: cloud account number(s), billing contact, PO number (if you want internal PO tracking)
- Timeline: Private offer creation by provider typically 2–3 business days once accepted

B) Redwood invoiced model (direct invoice):
- Benefit: Single vendor invoice to your AP team; Redwood handles tax and collections
- Requirements: Credit application (if net terms), W9/EIN, SOC2 cert provided on request
- Timeline: Finance setup 3–5 business days after paperwork is complete

If Sirius Edge intends to commit to reserved capacity (discounted committed spend), the marketplace private offer is preferable for SKU-level tracking and auto-billing. Otherwise, invoice path works for short proofs and pilots.

Lauren, flagging that for marketplace we’ll need the cloud account IDs from Aisha. Aisha, if you prefer Redwood invoice route, let us know and I’ll send credit/terms paperwork.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
